correctness.rationale: In a 231/312-avoider the inversion graph is a union of cliques: any induced two-edge path on three positions would be 231 or 312. A clique containing positions i<j contains every intervening position, since an inversion from i to j forces at least one inversion with any intermediate position. These consecutive cliques are the decreasing layers, and the absence of cross-layer inversions determines the value order. Thus the n−1 bits are fair and independent. The terminal zero is correctly handled by the extra T0 in the matrix formula; the cut interpretation preserves first-order definability. Aperiodicity makes iteration of T0 stabilize at a fixed state within each closed class, so the finite chain converges and its stationary and absorption systems have rational solutions. In the pattern family, an overlap of length at most L is impossible by the final 1; for longer overlaps the shift is at most t+1 and the suffix includes the delimiter 1 among the first L characters, unlike the prefix. For a fixed start, conditioning on a designated marker there rules out all earlier overlapping hits; earlier disjoint hits depend solely on the prefix before it. This independently yields equal first-hit probabilities and justifies the replacement symmetry. Each marker ends in 1, so the terminal zero creates no extra hit. The k=floor((n−1)/N) independent blocks each hit one chosen marker with probability 2^−N; the case n−1<N is correctly covered. A pattern-at-x formula has N−1 nested existential position quantifiers and cut tests of rank two; least-start selection adds at most two, giving N+3. Disjunctions of O(b) patterns use polynomial written length, and endpoints a=0,b are valid. Bounded replay independently checked exact first-hit counts using the avoidance recurrence A_L=2A_(L−1)−b A_(L−N).
residual_risks: The replay checks b in {1,2,3,4,5,7,8} and word lengths N through N+5 only; the universal result uses the proof, not extrapolation. No optimal complexity bound is asserted.

originality.rationale: The October 26 indexed finding proves the same full rational spectrum for the same uniform layered class and logic, with the same exact finite-size first-marker identity and an exponential bound. Not only is its different marker family nonoverlapping, it mechanically gives at least as good size, convergence and rank bounds: with t=max(1,ceil(log2 b)), encode each t-bit label bit x as 1x. The length-2t payload then has no 00, so its 001-payload-1 marker has length 2t+4, one less than the frozen N. Its occurrence and least-start formulas give rank at most 2t+7 by the same direct quantifier count, and polynomial size. The alternative proof of rationality does not change the conclusion; the older entry even supplies effective evaluation from the sentence.
residual_risks: An external targeted search did not return a usable result, which is not evidence of absence. The exact indexed overlap is established directly. No judgment about historical publication precedence or the relationship between the records is made.
